title: Representability facts for an affine etale-relation quotient
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $U$ be an affine scheme over $S$, and let $(s,t):R\to U\times_SU$ [def-pc-fibre-product] be an etale equivalence relation with $s,t$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $F$ be the sheafification on $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site, def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the presheaf $T\mapsto U(T)/R(T)$. For every scheme $T$ over $S$ and map $T\to F$, the fibre product $T\times_F h_U$ is representable by a scheme over $T$; moreover, the diagonal map $F\to F\times F$ is representable (its pullback by every map from a scheme is a scheme).

source.place: Tag 0265 (presentation-quasi-compact), first and third representability steps; the proof uses Tags 02WU, 02WT, 023Q and the separated locally quasi-finite fppf descent lemmas.

proof.text: Put $q:h_U\to F$ and $j=(s,t)$. By [lem-trf-affine-etale-relation-separated-lqf], affineness of $U$ makes $s,t,j$ separated and locally quasi-finite; no separatedness of $S$ is needed.

Fix $a:h_T\to F$. Apply [lem-trf-quotient-map-fppf-local-models] using the property of $s$ from step 1. It gives the fppf sheaf $G=h_T\times_Fh_U$, an fppf covering $\{T_i\to T\}$, lifts $a_i$, and representing schemes $X_i=T_i\times_{a_i,U,s}R$ for its restrictions. Every $X_i\to T_i$ is separated and locally quasi-finite.

source.place: Tag 0265, lemma-presentation-quasi-compact, first representability step, local models.

proof.text: By [lem-trf-fppf-sheaf-representability-descent-data], the local models $X_i$ of $G$ carry scheme descent data with the overlap comparison maps supplied by their sheaf identifications. By [lem-trf-separated-lqf-fppf-effective-descent] these data are effective, because all $X_i\to T_i$ are separated and locally quasi-finite. The representability-if-effective clause of [lem-trf-fppf-sheaf-representability-descent-data] therefore represents $G$ over $T$. This proves representability of $q$ for arbitrary $a$.

source.place: Tag 0265, lemma-presentation-quasi-compact, end of first representability step; Tags 02W5 and 02W8.

proof.text: Fix a map $h_T\to F\times F$ with components $a_1,a_2$. Apply [lem-trf-quotient-diagonal-fppf-local-models] using the property of $j$ from step 1. It gives the fppf sheaf $H=h_T\times_{F\times F}F$, simultaneous lifts $u_i,v_i$ on an fppf cover of $T$, and local representing schemes $Y_i=T_i\times_{(u_i,v_i),U\times_SU,j}R$. Each $Y_i\to T_i$ is separated and locally quasi-finite.

source.place: Tag 0265, lemma-presentation-quasi-compact, third representability step, local models for the diagonal.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-fppf-sheaf-representability-descent-data] to the local schemes $Y_i$ representing $H$. Their overlap comparison maps give descent data, effective by [lem-trf-separated-lqf-fppf-effective-descent] since the structure maps are separated and locally quasi-finite. The representability-if-effective clause of [lem-trf-fppf-sheaf-representability-descent-data] represents $H$ over $T$. As $T$ and $(a_1,a_2)$ were arbitrary, the diagonal is representable.

source.place: Tag 0265, lemma-presentation-quasi-compact, final paragraph; Tags 02W5 and 02W8.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0265, lemma-presentation-quasi-compact, first and third representability steps; for the diagonal use the common fppf refinement of local representatives directly.

lean.statement: theorem etale_affine_quotient_representable {S : Scheme.{u}} {R U : Over S} [IsAffine U.left] (s t : R ⟶ U) [Mono (prod.lift s t)] (hrel : ∀ T : Over S, Equivalence (fun a b : T ⟶ U ↦ ∃ r : T ⟶ R, r ≫ s = a ∧ r ≫ t = b)) [Etale s.left] [Etale t.left] (F : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u)) (η : coequalizer (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ⟶ F.obj) (hη : ∀ G : Sheaf (Scheme.fppfTopology.over S) (Type u), Function.Bijective (fun g : F.obj ⟶ G.obj ↦ η ≫ g)) : IsRepresentable (coequalizer.π (yoneda.map s) (yoneda.map t) ≫ η) ∧ IsRepresentable (prod.lift (𝟙 F.obj) (𝟙 F.obj))
